Honest-Broker Custody, Two-Person Re-Identification & Server Workflows

Source: vignettes/honest_broker_and_server.Rmd
honest_broker_and_server.Rmd

Overview

dicomtk.server provides multi-user research server orchestration and walled-off honest-broker key custody for clinical DICOM studies:

  1. 8-Role OIDC/Keycloak RBAC: pi, coordinator, annotator, auditor, admin, site_admin, honest_broker, and dpo.
  2. SHA-256 Hash-Chained Audit Log: Every de-identification, re-ID request, approval, disclosure, QA review, and job submission is appended to a tamper-evident JSONL ledger.
  3. Walled-Off Custody Enclave: Master keys and patient-identity crosswalks live inside an isolated closure inaccessible to pi and non-broker roles.
  4. Two-Person Re-Identification: Requires distinct honest_broker and dpo principals to approve a request before time-limited disclosure.

Quick Walkthrough 

library(dicomtk.server)

tmp_dir <- tempfile("dicomtk_vig_")
ctx <- server_create_context(work_dir = tmp_dir, jwt_secret = "vignette-secret")

adm <- server_principal("adm-1", roles = "admin", project_ids = "*")
pi <- server_principal("pi-1", roles = "pi", project_ids = "nsclc-01")
hb <- server_principal("hb-1", roles = "honest_broker", project_ids = "*")
dpo <- server_principal("dpo-1", roles = "dpo", project_ids = "*")

project_create(ctx$projects, "nsclc-01", title = "NSCLC Radiomics")
#> $project_id
#> [1] "nsclc-01"
#> 
#> $title
#> [1] "NSCLC Radiomics"
#> 
#> $deid_profile
#> [1] "ps3.15"
#> 
#> $custody_mode
#> [1] "broker"
#> 
#> $created_at
#> [1] "2026-11-14T13:46:50Z"
project_list(ctx$projects)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   project_id title           deid_profile custody_mode created_at          
#>   <chr>      <chr>           <chr>        <chr>        <chr>               
#> 1 nsclc-01   NSCLC Radiomics ps3.15       broker       2026-11-14T13:46:50Z

# Verify audit chain integrity
audit_verify(ctx$logger)
#> $passed
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $n_entries
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $corrupted_line
#> [1] NA

unlink(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
